releases.notes:
## PickUp Extender v1.0.1 for Minecraft 1.21.6

### Changes
- Updated to Minecraft 1.21.6
- Updated Fabric API to 0.127.0+1.21.6
- Updated Yarn mappings to 1.21.6+build.1
- **Fixed Java version requirement to >=17 (was incorrectly >=21)**

### Installation
- Download the JAR file below
- Place it in your \.minecraft/mods\ folder
- Requires Fabric Loader 0.16.14+
- Requires Fabric API
- **Requires Java 17+ (compatible with standard Minecraft Java runtime)**

### Dependencies
**Required:**
- Fabric API (>=0.127.0+1.21.6)
- Fabric Loader (>=0.16.14)

**Optional:**
- ModMenu (>=15.0.0-beta.3) - for in-game configuration

### Features
- Extends pickup range for items in the world
- Configurable distance through ModMenu
- Toggle on/off with keybinding
- Real-time pickup range display

releases.notes:
✨ What's New in v1.0.1

### Fixed
- **Hotkey reliability issues** - The "P" key toggle now responds immediately without delays or queuing
- **Key handling performance** - Hotkeys are now processed every client tick for consistent responsiveness

### Changed
- **Hotkey processing** - Moved from ItemEntity.tick() to MinecraftClient.tick() for better reliability
- **Code organization** - Improved separation of concerns between pickup logic and key handling

### Known Issues
- HUD status overlay temporarily disabled (visual only, doesn't affect functionality)
